title: Porthleven Gibson Memorial
memorial_details: Two memorials to Wing Commander Guy Penrose Gibson VC, reflecting a family connection to Porthleven: a harbour wall plaque (what3words: ///searches.spring.porridge) and a churchyard memorial stone (what3words: ///cheat.polygraph.savers).
narrative: Wing Commander Guy Penrose Gibson VC DSO* DFC*, leader of 617 Squadron's Dams Raid on 16-17 May 1943, had a family connection to Porthleven in Cornwall. Two memorials in Porthleven honour his memory: a plaque on the harbour wall and a memorial stone in the churchyard.
community_connection: Gibson had a family connection to Porthleven. Both memorials were documented by local resident Rob Davis.
